items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: But some of the records we made though were made in New York and Clarence Williams played for us.

ctx.x: And then here he lived with us. Oh, here in Chicago. Yes. He lived right in the house with us.

But some of the records we made though were made in New York and Clarence Williams played for us. He happened to be there. Yes. He wasn't traveling with us at that time. But once we were here and needed a trumpet player and punch, we got left down south or something. Oh, he turned out to be a kind of boozer. That's what it was. And we had to let him go.
